author: Temminck, 1835
status: 나그네새 수만 마리 · 겨울철새 수천 마리 · 텃새 수천 마리
habitat: 나무 구멍, 건물 지붕과 틈, 돌담 틈(둥지 자리)
summary: 우리나라 전역에서 번식하는 텃새이자 해마다 수만 마리가 지나가는 흔한 나그네새이며, 중부 이남에서는 겨울을 나기도 한다. 나무 구멍, 건물 지붕이나 틈, 돌담 틈, 딱따구리가 쓰던 둥지 등에 둥지를 틀고 3월 하순~7월경에 알을 4~6개 낳는다. 번식기에는 암수가 함께 지내고 그 밖의 때에는 대개 무리를 지으며, 무엇이든 먹는 잡식성이다. 유라시아 대륙 동부와 일본 등지에서 번식한다.

sexes.male: 머리와 멱, 가슴이 검은빛이 도는 짙은 잿빛이어서 회갈색 몸과 대비가 뚜렷하다.
sexes.female: 수컷보다 전체적으로 갈색을 띠고 가슴과 배가 옅으며, 검은색이 머리꼭대기에 그치고 얼굴의 흰 부분이 더 넓다.

young: 어린새는 전체가 갈색을 띠고, 머리와 가슴이 어른새처럼 검지 않고 회갈색이며, 뺨이 희끄무레하다.

similar.how: 붉은부리찌르레기 수컷은 머리 전체가 희끄무레하고 부리가 붉으며 허리에 흰 띠가 없고 날 때 첫째날개깃 기부에 흰 무늬가 보이지만, 찌르레기는 머리가 검고 뺨이 희며 허리에 흰 띠가 있다.

art.subject: White-cheeked Starling (Sturnus cineraceus), adult male, as seen in Korea in spring: head and throat blackish with a slight green gloss and long, narrow willow-leaf-shaped feathers; the amount of white on the face varies a lot between individuals: this one is a white-faced bird, with the forehead, lores, cheeks and ear coverts largely white, finely streaked black, clearly contrasting with the black crown, nape and throat; upperparts dull grey-brown; breast dark grey-brown, belly paler grey; vent and undertail coverts whitish; a pale whitish band across the rump; wings dark brown with narrow pale edges to the secondaries; tail dark brown with white tips to the outer feathers. Bill orange with a dark tip. Brown iris. Orange legs.
art.pose: perched at the entrance of a tree-hole nest
art.scene: Korean spring countryside: an old tree with a hollow beside a stone wall; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched, a white-faced individual: forehead, lores, cheeks and ear coverts largely white with fine black streaks, contrasting with the black crown, nape and throat; dark grey-brown body, orange bill with a dark tip, brown iris, orange legs

adult, side view perched, a dark-faced individual of the same species and build: head almost wholly blackish, the white reduced to a small streaked patch on the cheeks and ear coverts; same body, bill and legs
art.build: Medium-sized, sleek, slender starling, about 24cm, a little shorter than a Brown-eared Bulbul: flat crown and long sloping forehead running into the long bill, slim body, short square tail, so it looks pointed at the front and not round. Bill straight, pointed, about as long as the head, orange with a dark tip. Legs medium length, orange. Wings long and pointed; at rest the wingtips reach near the tail tip. In flight triangular wings, a white band across the rump and white corners to the dark tail. Walks briskly on lawns and fields, often in noisy flocks.
avoid: Do not paint iridescent purple-green plumage with white spots — that is Common Starling (Sturnus vulgaris).
Do not paint a pale grey head with a red bill (Red-billed Starling).
Do not paint a black or yellow bill; it is orange with a dark tip.
Do not paint a long tail; it is short and square.
Do not paint a plump, round-headed, thrush-like bird; it is a slender starling with a flat crown and long pointed bill.
